metadata.description: A curated set of Agent Skills for Claude from atroxabot.com

plugins.name: writing-skills
plugins.description: Skills for writing and editing prose: a humanizer that removes the patterns that make text read as AI-written, LinkedIn posts built on the 2026 feed rules, repurposing one source into platform-native pieces, and cold outreach emails, sequences and DMs that get replies without hurting deliverability

plugins.name: engineering-skills
plugins.description: Skills for engineering work: directive, agent-ready implementation specs, checking and fixing a domain's email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), idiomatic, high-assurance, high-performance Rust (CLIs, services, libraries, firmware), and Rust GUI apps on raw wgpu and winit

plugins.name: business-skills
plugins.description: Skills for business operations, starting with invoice and receipt extraction that validates every figure and flags invoices that shouldn't be paid as-is
